title: South Louisiana Redfishing Charters
specs: Fishing in calm, fertile marshes of Vermilion Bay and Marsh Island
Targeting the 'Big Five' species including redfish and speckled trout
Access to world-class Cajun cuisine and culture in nearby Lafayette
Expert local guide with three generations of knowledge
Lotion sunscreen, hat and polarized glasses
Two anglers included in base price; additional anglers $100 each; maximum four passengers

options.name: Extended fishing charter
options.detail: Longer trip to cover more water and pursue multiple species when conditions support it, for two anglers.

variants.label: Longer trip to cover more water and pursue multiple species when conditions support it, for two anglers.

blurb: Guests fish for redfish, speckled trout, black drum, flounder, and seasonal species in the protected inshore waters of Vermilion Bay and Marsh Island. Trips focus on the unique ecosystem with expert local guidance to maximize catch and experience. The charters include boat, fuel, tackle, bait, and personal essentials guidance.
extraNote: Capt. Troy personally confirms availability, pricing and best trip for your crew · Capt. Troy watches conditions and handles weather decisions and rescheduling · Most trips launch from Cypremort Point, south of Lafayette, Louisiana. · Year-round with seasonal species and conditions.
